name: Shadowmoor Brigid Baeli
description: Brigid's Shadowmoor incarnation, distrusting and curt but never maliciously cruel, with no memory of her adventures with Maralen and Ashling.

timeline.summary: Oko brings Isilu to Goldmeadow; the town becomes Mistmeadow and Brigid becomes her Shadowmoor self.
timeline.quote: for the first time in her long and storied life, Brigid became her Shadowmoor self.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "Eclipsed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eirdu restores Mistmeadow to Goldmeadow and the kithkin to themselves.
timeline.quote: another student returned, bringing Lorwyn's incarnation, Eirdu , which restored Mistmeadow to Goldmeadow and the kithkin to their former selves.
